name: Bundle of Hides
summary: Across the Barrens, a Bundle of Hides rides with the Horde’s wind riders toward Thunder Bluff. The cured skins are bound for the leatherworkers, and their delivery shows travelers how the wind rider network carries goods.

sections.title: Frontier Trade
sections.body: Hunters cure the hides of beasts found across the Barrens. Kodo graze the plains, while lions prowl and raptors roam. The leatherworkers of Thunder Bluff use these skins for gear, pouches, armor, and bindings for the Horde.

sections.title: Skyward Freight
sections.body: Couriers carry the bundle from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff on Devrak’s trained wyverns. The overland way through the Barrens and into Mulgore is slow and dangerous, with quilboar and centaur raiders abroad. By wind rider, the hides cross Kalimdor’s broken terrain swiftly.

faq.q: What is the Bundle of Hides used for?
faq.answer: The Bundle of Hides carries skins gathered from animals across the Barrens to Ahanu, a leatherworker in Thunder Bluff. He makes leather goods and armaments for the tauren and their Horde allies.

faq.q: Who receives the shipment in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Ahanu receives the parcel at Hewa’s Armory, at the base of Thunder Bluff’s wind rider roost.

faq.q: Why send this bundle via a wind rider?
faq.answer: The journey from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff takes days on foot and risks ambush by centaur or quilboar. Devrak, the Crossroads flight master, sends the goods atop a wind rider so they arrive swiftly and safely.

faq.q: Who prepared the bundle in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing prepared the bundle from animals of the Barrens. He sells leather and mail armor at the Crossroads and works with Ahanu.

angles.text: Simple shipments of pelts cross the sky on wyvern flight paths, linking isolated Horde outposts with their capital cities.
As a tauren, you use natural materials and hunt with reverence. Hides from the neighboring savanna become armor and crafts sold in Mulgore’s stalls.
